added.fullDescription:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic's complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role:
We're hiring an AI Forward Deployed Automation Engineer to lead AI agentic deployments and deliver real impact for our customers. This is a great opportunity to work at the intersection of engineering and customer success!

In this role, you'll design and develop tailored solutions using the Elastic Agent Builder platform and related technologies, guide technical engagements, and support the growth of junior engineers. The work spans from concept through deployment, requiring strong problem-solving skills and a collaborative approach to delivering value in complex, real-world environments.

What You Will Be Doing:

Technical Delivery and Implementation
Own the end-to-end technical delivery of AI solutions, including writing code, configuring systems, and resolving issues, while reviewing the work of junior team members to ensure quality deployment and measurable business impact.

AI Solution Development
Take ownership of designing and implementing scalable production systems, including AI and Large Language Model (LLM) based intelligent agents and automated workflows built on the Salesforce platform.

Custom Agentic AI Engineering
Work directly with stakeholders to design and build custom intelligent agents using the Elastic Agent Builder platform, ensuring solutions meet unique business requirements and integrate smoothly with existing tool ecosystems.

Data Configuration and Integration
Own the full data lifecycle, from data model design to building efficient processing pipelines and establishing integration strategies. Ensure data is optimized and secure for AI applications, including in complex enterprise environments.

Technical Problem Solving
Identify, analyze, and resolve technical challenges across all phases of solution delivery, from data integration to model deployment and agent orchestration. Serve as a reliable resource for unblocking progress.

Agentic Innovation
Develop expertise in the Elastic platform, pushing its capabilities forward. Lead the development of custom intelligent agents, automate business processes, and shape user experiences. Insights from the field will directly influence product enhancements and platform direction.

Client Partnership
Embed with client teams to understand their operational challenges and goals. Translate requirements into clear technical designs, build strong relationships, and serve as a trusted technical advisor.

Debugging and Root Cause Analysis
Perform thorough analysis, debugging, and root cause identification for complex system interactions, data flows, and AI model behaviors to optimize performance and prevent recurring issues.

Prototyping and Iteration
Rapidly develop proofs-of-concept and minimum viable products, often coding alongside client teams to demonstrate capabilities and gather feedback for iterative refinement.

Engineering Best Practices
Apply and promote standards for code quality, scalability, security, and maintainability across all deployed solutions.

What You Bring:
Experience in a hands-on, end-to-end delivery role for scalable production solutions in a professional environment
Expert-level proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., JavaScript, Java, Python)
Extensive experience building and deploying solutions with AI/LLM technologies, including integrating LLMs, applying AI orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex), prompt engineering techniques, and agentic frameworks
Deep expertise in data modeling, processing, integration, and analytics, with proficiency in enterprise data platforms (e.g., Salesforce Data Cloud, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
Strong collaboration, communication, and presentation skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical partners
Track record of leading technical engagements, mentoring junior team members, and taking responsibility for technical aspects of projects

Bonus Points:
Experience developing and deploying conversational AI solutions
Expert-level experience with Python in a professional setting
Prior experience in a solution engineering or technical lead role
Experience contributing to open-source AI frameworks or libraries

About the Role

Abnormal Security is seeking a Detection Machine Learning Manager to lead our Message Security Detection team. In this role, you'll oversee the development and optimization of machine learning models that detect sophisticated email threats including phishing, business email compromise (BEC), malware, and other advanced threats.

As Detection ML Manager, you'll:

- Lead a team of machine learning engineers focused on building and improving detection models
- Own the end-to-end ML pipeline from data collection and feature engineering to model training, evaluation, and deployment
- Collaborate with product, engineering, and security teams to translate business requirements into ML solutions
- Drive continuous improvement of detection accuracy, latency, and false positive rates
- Establish best practices for model development, testing, and monitoring in production
- Mentor and develop your team members, fostering a culture of innovation and technical excellence
- Evaluate and integrate new ML techniques, frameworks, and tools to stay at the forefront of the field
- Manage resources, prioritize work, and deliver results on aggressive timelines
- Present technical findings and recommendations to senior leadership

What You'll Build

You'll be responsible for building and maintaining the ML systems that power Abnormal's core email security detection capabilities. This includes:

- Supervised and unsupervised learning models for threat classification and anomaly detection
- Feature engineering pipelines that extract signals from email metadata, content, and behavioral patterns
- Model serving infrastructure that processes millions of emails daily with sub-second latency requirements
- Evaluation frameworks that measure model performance against real-world threat data
- Explainability and interpretability systems that provide customers visibility into why threats were detected

The detection models you build directly impact the security posture of Abnormal's enterprise customers, protecting them from the most sophisticated email-based attacks.

About You

You have:

- 5+ years of experience in machine learning engineering or data science, with 2+ years in a leadership or management role
- Deep expertise in supervised learning, classification, and anomaly detection techniques
- Experience building and deploying ML models in production environments at scale
- Strong understanding of model evaluation, validation, and monitoring methodologies
- Proficiency in Python and common ML frameworks (scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, etc.)
- Experience with data pipeline tools and platforms (Spark, Airflow, or similar)
- Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex ML concepts to non-technical stakeholders
- Proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop engineering teams
- Experience in security, fraud detection, or related domains is a plus
- BS in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or related field (or equivalent experience)

Why Join Abnormal Security

Abnormal Security is the leader in AI-powered email security, protecting enterprises from advanced threats. We're a well-funded, fast-growing company with:

- A talented team of security researchers, ML engineers, and product experts
- Cutting-edge technology that combines AI/ML with behavioral analysis
- An opportunity to have real impact on security outcomes for thousands of enterprises
- Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits
- A collaborative, innovative culture that values technical excellence
